name: Thicket Dryad Lich

alignment.name: Evil
alignment.description:
Evil creatures don’t necessarily go out of their way to hurt people, but they’re perfectly willing to take advantage of the weakness of others to acquire what they want.
	Evil creatures use rules and order to maximize personal gain. They don’t care whether laws hurt other people. They support institutional structures that give them power, even if that power comes at the expense of others’ freedom. Slavery and rigid caste structures are not only acceptable but desirable to evil creatures, as long as they are in a position to benefit from them.

description: This is the size of a typical human and serves as a standard in the game. This category has no special rules.

traits.name: Death Thorns
traits.details: any creature without forest walk takes 5 necrotic damage each time it moves or is pushed, pulled, or slid into a square within the aura.

traits.name: Thorny Body
traits.details: A creature that a thicket dryad lich has grabbed takes 10 damage when the dryad sustains the grab.

traits.name: Indestructible
traits.details: When a thicket dryad lich is reduced to 0 hit points, it dissipates into a spray of dead leaves, but it is not truly destroyed. It reappears in 1d10 days within 1 square of its phylactery tree, unless the phylactery tree is also found and destroyed.

auras.name: Death Thorns
auras.details: any creature without forest walk takes 5 necrotic damage each time it moves or is pushed, pulled, or slid into a square within the aura.

effect.description: A thicket dryad lich can disguise itself to appear as any Medium humanoid, usually a beautiful elf or eladrin. A successful Insight check (opposed by the dryad’s Bluff check) pierces the disguise.

A thicket dryad lich teleports up to 8 squares if it begins and ends the move adjacent to a tree, a treant, or a plant of Large size or bigger. When it teleports in this manner, a thicket dryad lich deals 10 necrotic damage to all nonplant creatures adjacent to it at the end of the teleport.
